name: compute_masked_offset_difference
description: Packs three global byte values into one word, subtracts a field read from the current record, and returns the result masked to 24 bits. Three routines call it.

name: store_bytes_and_accumulate_field
description: Writes three global byte values into consecutive fields of the current record, adds the incoming register value to a 32-bit field, then clears the low byte of that field.

name: poll_disk_transfer_completion
description: Loops calling two routines until a status bit in the record is set, then stores a result code and a counter in the record. It touches the disk length and interrupt request registers.

name: save_frame_and_start_timer
description: Saves the full processor register set into a stack frame, links the frame into the record, then writes a short sequence of values to CIA-B timer and interrupt registers.

name: clear_flag_and_tail_call
description: Zeroes one global word and then calls another routine before returning. Its entry was found only by decoding a gap between known routines, not by a direct call.

name: acknowledge_cia_b_interrupt
description: Sets a global to one, then writes the external interrupt bit to the interrupt request and interrupt enable registers, acknowledging and disabling the CIA-B interrupt source.

name: pick_stack_buffer_and_read
description: Tests low bits of a stack argument, selects one of two stack buffers using a swapped global pointer, clears the CIA-B interrupt request bit, and returns a longword from the chosen buffer.

name: restart_cia_timer_if_armed
description: Checks two status bits in a flag byte and a non-zero global; when both hold, writes two values to the CIA-B timer control and interrupt registers, otherwise it returns without action.

name: unpack_backward_rle_stream
description: Checks a four-byte signature, then unpacks a backward-running run-length stream from its end, using signed count bytes for literal copies and repeated bytes, and writes the saved header fields back afterwards.

name: copy_blocks_and_check_index
description: Copies a block of longwords into a fixed memory area, copies a second block when a size is non-zero, and raises a processor trap when an index is out of range. The tail of the decoded routine is bad data.

name: run_single_pass_poll_loop
description: Calls one routine inside a loop whose exit flag is set before the loop body runs, so only one pass happens; a second call in the body is never reached in this decompiled form.

name: init_hardware_and_xor_decrypt
description: Blanks the sprite and colour registers, disables DMA and interrupts, fills interrupt vectors with a stub, then XOR-decrypts a 192-byte block with a rotating 32-bit key before validating it.

name: wait_cia_a_clear_color
description: Spins while bit 7 of the CIA-A port A register is set, runs a fixed countdown, then clears the background colour register.

name: select_first_successful_probe
description: Calls up to three routines in sequence, stopping at the first whose zero flag is clear, and stores that routine's result; if none qualifies it stores zero.

name: probe_longword_writable_and_restore
description: Reads a longword, writes its bitwise complement, and reads it back; if the complement was stored it restores the original value, which tests whether the location is writable.

name: build_record_list_reset_audio
description: Scans a byte table for an index, and at its end builds a linked list of thirty records from a computed base, clears the four audio volume registers and resets status globals.

name: refresh_audio_channel_pointers
description: Increments a frame counter; on wrap it resets state, waits briefly, and copies four audio channel pointer pairs into the location registers while advancing a stepped offset. Otherwise it calls routines and loops back.

name: decode_protracker_channel_note
description: Reads a four-byte note packet, updates the channel period and sample pointer, and handles ProTracker-style effects for volume, pattern break, position jump and speed.

name: apply_per_tick_channel_effects
description: Runs once per tick for one channel and applies arpeggio, portamento, tone slide, vibrato and volume slide effects to the period and volume, selected by the effect code.

name: parse_iff_chunk_list
description: Walks a chunk list with four-character type identifiers, calls handlers for the header, colour map and body chunks, and records the positions of the delta chunks in a table.

name: wait_then_copy_longword_block
description: Calls one routine, waits until a pending flag global is clear, copies a fixed block of 24 longwords from a source pointer to a destination pointer, then clears the flag.

name: decode_rle_into_plane_rows
description: Decodes a signed-count run-length stream into a grid of rows, writing literal bytes or repeated bytes at a fixed row stride and advancing the output by a plane offset after each row.

name: record_anim_chunk_pointer
description: Checks whether the chunk tag at offset eight is the ANIM type and, if so, stores the field at offset four into a global.

name: set_chunk_data_pointer
description: Stores the address of the chunk data in a global, then runs a byte copy loop whose source and destination are the same buffer, so the loop leaves memory unchanged.

name: store_chunk_data_address
description: Stores the address eight bytes past the chunk base into a global, marking where the chunk payload begins.

name: advance_frame_and_draw_entries
description: Walks a table of pointers for the current frame index, calls a drawing routine on each non-empty entry with a per-row offset, then advances the frame index and wraps it around.

name: decode_column_rle_stream
description: Decodes a run-length stream into a buffer written column by column at a fixed row stride, where zero bytes introduce repeated values and positive bytes advance through a lookup table of offsets.

name: decode_column_literal_runs
description: Writes literal runs and repeated values into a column-major buffer at a fixed row stride, advancing by lookup-table offsets for skips, and returns when the column count is exhausted.

name: decode_column_offset_runs
description: Decodes column-major data with a lookup-table offset per step, writing either literal runs or repeated values at a fixed row stride until the column counter runs out.

name: decode_column_mixed_runs
description: Writes literal runs and repeated values into a column-major buffer at a fixed row stride, advancing by lookup-table offsets, and returns when the column count is exhausted.

name: verify_delta_chunk_tags
description: Checks that every entry in a pointer table refers to a chunk tagged as delta data; if one does not, the routine enters an endless loop.

name: poll_fire_button_state
description: Reads status flags from the CIA-A port register, updates a fire-button state global, calls two routines when the button flag is set, and touches the audio volume registers.

name: step_palette_toward_target
description: Moves each byte of a palette buffer one step toward a target table in units of sixteen, then packs nibble pairs into colour words for 32 entries and writes the changed ones back.

name: copy_longword_groups_with_tail
description: Copies a large block from one buffer to another in groups of twelve longwords, then copies the remaining words up to a fixed end address.

name: fill_table_with_flag_value
description: Fills a memory table with zero or all-one words depending on a flag, in four passes that step back between passes.

name: fill_indexed_table_row
description: Fills one indexed row of a table with zero or all-one longwords depending on a flag, repeating in four passes that step back between passes.

name: wait_blitter_idle
description: Spins while the blitter busy bit in the DMA control read register is set, returning once the blitter is idle.

name: write_bitplane_pointer_list
description: Writes four pairs of high and low bitplane addresses into a list at a fixed plane stride, then writes end-of-list words.

name: init_cia_a_registers
description: Sets the CIA-A control and interrupt values, fills a 32-entry longword table with all-one values, and writes a fixed value to a port byte.

name: set_default_state_globals
description: Writes five fixed initial values into a block of globals, two zeroes followed by the constants 40, 256 and 4, with no further logic.

name: run_setup_then_repeat_calls
description: Stores two input values into globals, runs a sequence of setup routines, then calls a routine repeatedly for a count held in a global before returning.

name: chain_two_routine_calls
description: Calls one routine and then another, and returns without changing any data itself.

name: wait_timed_then_flag_clear
description: Optionally spins until a timing difference reaches a count passed in a register, calls a routine, then spins until a global flag becomes zero. The CIA-A port flag bit selects the timed wait.

name: stub_self_assign_globals
description: Assigns three globals to themselves, leaving their values unchanged, and returns.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls a single routine outside this segment and returns, with no other work.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decoded bytes are only a bad instruction followed by a halt, so the routine has no real behaviour and only stops the decoder.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: examine_unresolved_routine_body
description: No pseudo-code was produced for this 14-instruction routine, so its behaviour is not established. The listed facts show only that it runs during the reference run and is entered from outside the static flow.

name: build_region_table_and_copy
description: Walks a linked list of memory regions to compute a destination address, copies a block of 2,448 longwords to it, then raises a processor trap; the tail is bad data.

name: init_chipset_and_copy_vectors
description: Sets the background colour and display registers, copies and clears a 1,024-entry vector block, calls a series of setup routines, and copies a 1,249-longword block into allocated memory.

name: clear_pending_interrupt_requests
description: Writes a fixed mask to the interrupt request register so that all pending interrupt request bits are cleared.

name: store_callback_and_set_flag
description: Calls three routines, stores a code pointer into a fixed slot of a global structure, and sets the top bit of a 16-bit field in the caller's record.

name: store_callback_and_set_flag
description: Repeats the same call, pointer store and flag set as its neighbouring routine; the listed facts show one call and one call-back from outside.

name: set_byte_and_fill_longword
description: Writes 255 to a global byte and sets a fixed 32-bit memory location to all ones.

name: store_word_to_global
description: Copies the incoming 16-bit data register value into a global word and returns.

name: store_callback_and_set_flag
description: Calls three routines, stores a code pointer into a fixed slot of a global structure, and sets the top bit of a 16-bit field in the caller's record. One of its calls is an empty stub.

name: set_global_self_reference
description: Stores the address of itself into a global variable and returns. The routine writes a pointer to its own code into a global variable.

name: clear_two_status_globals
description: Zeroes a global and a fixed memory word and returns, with no other work.

name: call_two_routines_set_flag
description: Calls two routines and then sets the top bit of a 16-bit field in the caller's record, returning the saved register pair.

name: store_adjusted_field_conditionally
description: Calls two routines and, when the result is not negative, stores a record field minus three into a global; otherwise it returns without storing.

name: store_field_minus_three
description: Stores a record field minus three, as an unsigned 16-bit value, into a global variable.

name: empty_routine
description: Contains only a return and performs no work when called.

name: hash_text_until_colon
description: Walks a text string and folds each character into a rotating accumulator, recording the running position in the record, until it reaches a colon. If the string ends first it sets an error status and returns zero.

name: set_status_minus_ten
description: Sets a global status value to minus ten and returns.

name: empty_routine
description: Contains only a return and performs no work when called.

name: set_selector_and_poll_status
description: Validates a two-bit selector against an allowed mask, stores it in the record, adjusts bits in a control byte through routine calls, then polls for a bounded number of passes and records a timeout status if the poll fails.

name: apply_selector_and_poll
description: Applies a two-bit selector to the record and control byte through routine calls, then polls for a bounded number of passes and records a timeout status if the poll fails.

name: validate_selector_and_poll
description: Checks that a selector value is in range and enabled in a mask, then stores it and runs a bounded polling loop that sets a timeout status on failure.

name: apply_masked_selector_and_poll
description: Takes the low two bits of a register value plus three as a selector, updates control bits, and runs a bounded polling loop that sets a timeout status when it fails.

name: poll_status_after_bit_update
description: Clears a control bit, calls two routines, sets a flag bit, then polls for a bounded number of passes and sets a timeout status if the poll fails.

name: set_status_minus_eleven
description: Sets a global status value to minus eleven and returns.

name: clear_and_set_flag
description: Clears the lowest bit of a byte addressed by a register twice, then sets that bit, leaving it set.

name: reset_and_store_pending_value
description: When a status global is non-negative and a record field is non-zero, zeroes that field, stores a fixed value in the record, and writes a saved word through a pointer while calling routines.

name: store_longword_via_pointer
description: Writes a longword through the pointer held in the record, calls a routine, and returns the saved register pair.

name: unpack_pack_tagged_stream
description: Unpacks a stream tagged with the four-character PaCk marker, copying literal bytes or repeating a marker-run byte for a count, while tracking input and output budgets. Without the tag it copies raw bytes up to the output limit.

name: unpack_pack_repeat_bytes
description: Continues the tagged unpack by copying byte runs or repeating a run byte for a count, updating the input and output budgets and the stored output pointer.

name: decode_marker_run_pairs
description: Decodes byte pairs in a run-length scheme: a repeated byte with a count, followed by literal bytes between markers, decrementing the input and output budgets as it goes.

name: resume_marker_run_decode
description: Resumes a marker-run decode from the middle of a run, writing the remaining copies of the saved byte, then copies literal bytes while counts remain.

name: update_state_byte_with_steps
description: Stores a new low-bit state in a per-channel table entry, sets or clears a flag bit in a control byte, and steps through routine calls that cover the change between the old and new values.

name: store_state_byte_and_step
description: Stores the upper bits of a value into a per-channel table entry, sets a control flag, and steps through routine calls covering the change between the old and new entry.

name: set_flag_and_repeat_calls
description: Sets bit one of a control byte, then calls routines a count derived from two register inputs, and finishes with one more call.

name: accumulate_four_bit_poll_results
description: Loops four times testing a bit of a combined input value for each index, calls a routine when a condition holds, sets the matching accumulator bit from its result, then stores the accumulated value as a 16-bit field in the record.

name: set_control_bits_around_poll
description: Sets and clears bits of a control byte selected by an input value, calls a routine, then repeats the bit update using the value the routine returned.

name: poll_ciaa_pra_with_timeout
description: Repeats a call while two status bits in a global are set, stopping early when either clears or after a fixed large count, then returns two register values.

name: repeat_call_record_count
description: Calls a routine repeatedly, using a count taken from a field in the record, then returns the saved register pair.

name: wait_while_byte_matches
description: Spins while the input byte equals a byte at a fixed offset in the record, returning once they differ.

name: set_cia_b_range_bit
description: If a value lies between 2 and 6, updates the CIA-B port B register so the bit chosen by the value is set, keeping the other masked bits.

name: loop_with_wait_and_check
description: Calls a routine up to four times, returning early when a counter argument reaches zero or a global becomes negative.

name: build_copper_display_entries
description: Stores timing and display values into the record, waits on a status bit, searches a table for a matching entry and writes a sequence of display list words. A wait that times out sets a status code instead.

name: write_default_display_words
description: Writes a fixed sequence of display control words and a longword into the record, with no branching.

name: write_display_words_with_flag
description: Writes a fixed sequence of display control words into the record, setting one extra bit in the last word when an input value exceeds 79.

name: emit_display_entries_from_table
description: Searches a table for a matching entry, then writes a run of longwords stepping by a stride returned from a call, calling a routine for each entry.

name: emit_stepped_display_entries
description: Writes a run of longwords stepping by a stride returned from a call, calling a routine for each entry until the counter runs out.

name: emit_counted_display_entries
description: Writes a descending series of longwords using a stride from a call, calling a routine for each entry until the count reaches its end.

name: empty_routine
description: Contains only a return and performs no work when called.

name: scan_four_slots_for_match
description: Starts from a slot derived from a record field and steps through four slots, testing each slot's bit and calling routines to confirm a match. It returns on a confirmed match; otherwise it sets a timeout status.

name: scan_slots_with_index_bit
description: Steps through four indexed slots from a starting index, testing each slot's bit in a mask and calling routines to confirm a match. When the slots are exhausted it sets a timeout status.

name: store_input_to_global
description: Copies a longword input register value into a global and returns.

name: store_input_to_global
description: Copies a longword input register value into a global and returns; five routines call it.

name: call_then_read_record_word
description: Calls one routine and then returns a 16-bit field from the record.

name: unpack_bit_reader_stream
description: The decompiler timed out, so this rests on the listed facts: a 67-instruction routine that calls the depacker bit-reader refill and multi-bit read routines and writes the background colour register. The exact decoding loop is not recovered.

name: chain_three_routine_calls
description: Calls three routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

name: delay_between_routine_calls
description: Calls one routine, runs a full 16-bit countdown as a delay, then calls another routine and returns. The listed facts show a text reference to a four-character tag.

name: relocate_pointer_table
description: Adds a base offset to a block of pointer longwords and to a few pointer globals, relocating them to the load address, then returns.

name: copy_header_block_to_globals
description: Copies a block of sixteen longwords from a source pointer into consecutive global variables.

name: select_dma_channel_bit
description: If a channel index is below four, stores the matching single-bit mask in a global, otherwise it leaves the global unchanged.

name: scale_volume_by_table
description: Multiplies an input value by a table entry chosen by an index and by a record byte, then returns the scaled result as a packed pair of words.

name: start_voice_sample_playback
description: Checks a stored pointer for a voice and, when it is set, computes a volume from the inputs, updates the channel enable mask, scales the period through a routine, and stores pointer, length and period in the voice record.

name: start_voice_sample_direct
description: Sets a channel's bit in the enable mask when the channel index is valid, scales the period through a routine, and stores the pointer, length and period in the voice record.

name: store_voice_period_fields
description: Stores the period, pointer, length and volume fields for a voice into its record, using the requested period or a default when it is zero.

name: store_voice_sample_fields
description: Stores the sample pointer, period, length and volume fields for a voice into its record.

name: stub_infinite_loop
description: Contains no real work and enters an endless loop, so it never returns.

name: copy_channel_state_if_flagged
description: When the low bit of an input is set, copies a longword and a word from a fixed table entry into a buffer pointed to by a global, then returns the input shifted right by one bit.

name: run_channel_update_if_enabled
description: When a global enable word is non-zero, stores a value from one routine and calls four routines to update the channel, then copies a state longword and word when the low bit of the result is set.

name: set_voice_flags_and_request
description: Sets two status bits in a byte at an offset computed from the input record, calls one routine when a global flag is set, then writes the interrupt request bit into the global.

name: set_voice_flags_and_request
description: Repeats the same status bit update and interrupt request write as its neighbouring routine; the listed facts show the interrupt control register is also involved.

name: advance_song_order_position
description: Counts ticks per row and, on the sixth tick, advances the song order index with a loop-back limit, then fetches the pointer for the next pattern entry. The code is cut off before the end of the routine.

name: advance_voice_order_position
description: Counts ticks per row for one voice and, on the sixth tick, advances its order index using a limit read from the song header, then fetches the next pattern pointer. The code is cut off before the end of the routine.

name: process_packed_channel_rows
description: Resets decoding state, decodes a signed run stream into a buffer when the position counter is zero, then steps through four-byte packed row entries for each channel and dispatches their effect codes.

name: decode_runs_then_process_rows
description: Decodes a signed run stream into a buffer, then steps through four-byte packed row entries for each channel, setting period and volume and dispatching effect codes. The code is cut off before the end of the routine.

name: step_channel_row_entries
description: Walks four-byte packed row entries for each channel, stores the sample pointer and period for each one, and applies a small set of special effect codes before reading the next entry.

name: step_rows_short_effects
description: Walks packed row entries for each channel like its neighbouring routine, but handles only two special effect codes before reading the next entry.

name: step_rows_offset_effect
description: Walks packed row entries for each channel and applies one special effect code that updates a stored channel parameter from a lookup table before reading the next entry.

name: flag_channel_rows_and_step
description: Sets a channel status byte to all ones, then walks packed row entries for each channel, storing sample and period data before reading the next entry.

name: dispatch_channel_effect_codes
description: Walks packed row entries and dispatches effect codes for volume set, position jump and portamento, applying parameters from the packed data to the channel record.

name: dispatch_jump_and_slide_effects
description: Walks packed row entries and handles two effect codes: a position jump that records a new order position, and a portamento step that looks up a value from a table.

name: step_rows_tone_slide_effect
description: Walks packed row entries for each channel and handles a portamento-style effect code that takes a value from a table, and is called from nine routines.

name: apply_per_tick_pitch_slides
description: Applies per-tick effects to one voice: a slide that adds the parameter to the period and clamps it at 856, a table-driven step for another code, and a volume slide driven by the effect nibble.

name: apply_per_tick_volume_effects
description: Applies per-tick volume effects to one voice, including a volume slide, a fine volume adjustment and a table-driven step, selected by the effect code.

name: apply_per_tick_vibrato_effect
description: Applies a per-tick vibrato effect to one voice: it steps a phase counter, reads a table value scaled by the depth, and adjusts the period and volume from it.

name: set_volume_and_step_rows
description: Stores a volume clamped at 64 and the current period into a voice record, then walks packed row entries for the channels.

name: apply_tick_slide_and_vibrato
description: Applies per-tick effects to one voice, including a slide of the period, a table-driven vibrato step, and handling of special effect codes.

name: apply_per_tick_speed_effects
description: Applies per-tick effects to one voice, including vibrato steps and special effect codes that set or clear a flag bit, call a routine or read the speed setting.

name: set_period_and_step_rows
description: Compares a stored value with a limit, sets the voice period from the slide value and clears the pending value, then walks packed row entries for the voice.

name: apply_volume_effect_and_step
description: When the effect code is the volume set code and the channel flag allows it, stores the volume into the voice record, then walks packed row entries.

name: apply_vibrato_and_step_rows
description: Handles the vibrato effect by stepping a phase counter and a table value, updates the voice period and volume, and then walks packed row entries.

name: apply_slide_delta_and_step
description: Computes a slide delta from a stored value and an input, updates the phase counter, writes the period and volume to the voice record, and walks packed row entries.

name: dispatch_flag_and_timing_effects
description: Dispatches effect codes that set or clear a status bit, call a routine for timing-related codes, and otherwise walks packed row entries for the channels.

name: dispatch_timing_flag_effects
description: Dispatches a second group of effect codes that set or clear a status bit and conditionally call a routine, then walks packed row entries.

name: dispatch_status_flag_effects

name: dispatch_flag_effects_and_step
description: Dispatches effect codes that set or clear a status bit, calls a routine for one timing code when a status value allows it, then walks packed row entries.

name: set_clear_flag_and_step
description: Sets or clears a status bit for two effect codes, then walks packed row entries for the channels.

name: set_status_flag_and_step
description: Sets a status bit unconditionally, then walks packed row entries, applying a flag check to entries that require it.

name: walk_packed_row_entries
description: Walks packed row entries for the channels, storing the current volume and period into each voice record. Sixteen routines call it.

name: set_period_from_input
description: When a global flag is set, stores the input value in the record and, for values below eleven, takes a period from a table. Otherwise it divides a fixed constant of 470,000 by the input and stores the two bytes of the quotient in globals.

name: set_timer_count_from_divisor
description: Divides a fixed constant of 470,000 by the input and writes the two bytes of the quotient into the CIA-B timer count registers.

name: inspect_channel_state_only
description: Reads a channel state byte and returns without changing anything, because every tested case leads to the same return.

name: test_code_without_effect
description: Compares an input byte with two codes and returns in every case, so it has no effect.

name: load_pointer_and_offset_pair
description: Reads a longword through the input pointer and returns it together with the pointer advanced by six bytes.

name: forward_call_returning_pair
description: Calls one routine and returns the saved register pair unchanged.

name: init_audio_channel_structs
description: Stores the addresses of the four audio channel register blocks into per-channel structures, sets several globals from a status bit, writes interrupt, CIA-B control and serial period values, then returns zero.

name: stop_channels_restore_interrupts

name: forward_call_returning_pair
description: Calls one routine and returns the saved register pair unchanged.

name: start_channel_playback_state
description: When a state byte is set, resets the channel counters and status, selects a status bit from a channel flag, and when a second flag is set records the channel's instrument and calls a routine.

name: forward_call_returning_pair
description: Calls one routine and returns the saved register pair unchanged.

name: enable_channel_dma_trigger
description: When a state byte is set, writes the channel's interrupt enable value, records its sample index and status, calls a routine and sets the channel counters.

name: forward_call_returning_pair
description: Calls one routine and returns the saved register pair unchanged.

name: clear_channel_field_if_active
description: When a state byte is set and a channel pointer is non-zero, clears a channel field; otherwise it returns without change.

name: examine_port_status_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so this rests on the listed facts: a 10-instruction routine that reads the CIA-A and CIA-B port registers and the custom chip register block, and calls two routines.

name: pack_codes_into_bitplanes
description: Clears a 2,000-longword buffer, then makes eighteen passes over a byte code list, summing a lookup weight for each code and ORing shifted table bytes into the buffer at a fixed step per pass. It finishes by writing control words to the custom chip registers.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.compp:0:021C
name: examine_unresolved_routine_body
description: Pseudo-code could not be produced for this three-instruction routine, so its behaviour is not established. The listed facts show only that one routine calls it.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:0000
name: load_hunk_stream_sections
description: Walks an AmigaDOS hunk stream by comparing record types with hunk type codes and copies section data into memory, calling four routines per step. It also writes a colour register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:00F6
name: refill_bit_buffer_longword
description: Reads the longword before the input pointer, writes its low byte through an output pointer and returns the longword shifted right by one bit with its top bit set.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:0110
name: shift_bit_buffer_by_count
description: Shifts a bit buffer right by a count, one bit at a time, and when the buffer empties it calls a routine to refill it.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0000
name: configure_timing_and_wait
description: Calls four routines, stores a timing value that is larger when a status flag bit is set, waits until a second status bit clears, clears a value, then calls four more routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0066
name: map_event_code_to_slots
description: Compares an event code against a series of fixed codes; each match selects three slot numbers, and one code also stores a value in a structure. It loops, calling a routine on each pass.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:006C
name: reset_state_and_dispatch_events
description: Clears a 128-entry table to minus one and 32 state globals, then copies pending values between two tables with a scaled correction for active entries, and dispatches event codes through a comparison chain.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:012E
name: interpret_command_stream
description: Interprets a command stream: opcode bytes set or clear flags and select compare-and-branch operations on table values, and the routine returns when the pointer passes its block limit.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:045A
name: enter_interpreter_if_zero
description: Two-instruction entry that tests the zero flag and continues into the shared command loop, which reads the next command. The listed facts show one routine call.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0462
name: enter_interpreter_if_not_zero
description: Two-instruction entry that tests whether the zero flag is clear and continues into the shared command loop, which reads the next command. The listed facts show one routine call.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:046A
name: enter_interpreter_if_greater
description: Two-instruction entry that continues into the shared command loop only when the zero flag is clear and the overflow and negative flags agree. The listed facts show one routine call.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0472
name: enter_interpreter_if_at_least
description: Two-instruction entry that continues into the shared command loop when the overflow and negative flags agree. The listed facts show one routine call.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:047A
name: enter_interpreter_if_less
description: Two-instruction entry that continues into the shared command loop when the overflow and negative flags differ. The listed facts show one routine call.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0482
name: interpret_commands_with_flags
description: Interprets a command stream like its neighbouring routine, with compare-and-branch operations that use the condition flags. The low bits of each opcode choose one of eight comparison variants.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0654
name: draw_scaled_object_record
description: Decodes an object record with a six-bit type, computes scaled screen positions for the basic types, and for one record type writes bits into a 40-byte-stride buffer when the position lies within a 320 by 200 area, then loops over a count.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0704
name: walk_flagged_word_pairs
description: Loops over a count, reading word pairs and calling routines for each pair, and advances through the data by one word or three depending on whether the top bits of the pair are set.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0710
name: compute_record_address
description: Returns the address of an entry in a table of 20-byte records, computed from the index held in the data register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:071C
name: scan_records_and_emit_text
description: Searches a zero-terminated table for a matching key, then reads a text string byte by byte, skipping carriage returns and passing each other character to a routine until the terminator.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:075E
name: blit_masked_tile_rows
description: After checking that the column is under 40 and the row is under 193, applies an eight-row pattern to byte positions in three bitplanes, setting or clearing bits according to the mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:07DA
name: unpack_bit_reader_back_references
description: Depacker loop: reads flag bits through the bit reader and, for each flag, either copies a literal byte or a back-reference of a length taken from a short code table, until the output count ends. It calls the bit reader refill routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:088A
name: shift_bits_refill_with_sentinel
description: Shifts a 32-bit bit buffer right by a count, refilling it from the previous longword with its top bit set whenever it empties.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:08AA
name: select_highest_priority_entry
description: Scans a table of 20-byte entries for the type-two entry with the highest priority value and processes it by kind and timestamps; it returns when no entry qualifies. Text references show file and bank labels.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:09B4
name: format_word_as_text_digits
description: Converts a 16-bit value into four ASCII characters, one per nibble, using letters for values above nine, and leaves the last character in the result register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:09E6
name: allocate_entries_within_budget
description: Repeatedly takes the highest-priority matching entry, marks it active and subtracts its size from a budget, until the budget is exhausted, then calls a routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0A48
name: mark_queued_entries_until_budget
description: Marks entries from a starting pointer as active, subtracting their sizes from a budget and choosing the next highest-priority matching entry each time, until the budget runs out.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0A68
name: subtract_sizes_from_running_totals
description: Walks the entry table and, for each entry of kind four, calls a routine and subtracts its returned size from one of two running totals, chosen by a flag bit in the entry.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0AA6
name: subtract_budget_for_kind_four
description: Subtracts an amount from a budget, then walks the kind-four entries, calling a routine for each and subtracting its returned size from a running total unless a flag bit is set.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0AB4
name: return_stack_pair_unchanged
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without any other work.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0ABA
name: copy_buffer_up_to_limit
description: Copies 16-bit words from an input pointer to an output pointer, with the count taken from the distance to one of two limit globals selected by a flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0ADC
name: copy_words_in_full_blocks
description: Copies a first run of words, then copies a series of full blocks of 32,768 words each, repeating for the outer count.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0AE6
name: copy_blocks_and_adjust_entries
description: Copies a number of full blocks of 32,768 words, then walks the entry table and subtracts a value from each counter whose stored position is above a limit and whose kind bits match.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0B1C
name: return_stack_pair_unchanged
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without any other work.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0B22
name: dispatch_events_with_raster_timing
description: Dispatches event codes through a comparison chain, storing timing values in globals and calling routines for each event. The listed facts show it reads the raster position register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0C9E
name: clear_unmatched_entry_kinds
description: Clears the first byte of each 20-byte entry whose kind byte falls outside the range three to six, then restores two saved timing values.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0CE4
name: clear_all_entry_flags
description: Zeroes the first byte of every 20-byte entry, then restores two timing values from saved globals.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0D1A
name: count_table_entries_to_sentinel
description: Counts 20-byte table entries until a sentinel value is found and stores the count minus one in a global.
